meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会持续监视指定的拉取请求（PR），反复检查评论、审查和 CI 状态，修复发现的实际问题并推送更新，直到所有检查通过且无可操作评论或未解决线程才停止。
howto.when: 当用户要求照看（babysit）、监视（monitor）或持续检查 PR 的评论、审查与 CI 直到问题解决时触发。

say.text: 帮我 babysit PR #123，直到可以合并。
say.note: Claude 会持续监视该 PR 直到可合并。

say.text: 监视 #456 的 CI 和 review，有问题就修并推送。
say.note: Claude 会轮询检查并推送修复。

say.text: 照看 #789，解决所有评论并确认通过后再报告。
say.note: Claude 会验证代码后解决线程并报告。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude will continuously watch a specified pull request, re-checking comments, reviews, and CI status, fixing real issues found and pushing updates, and stop only when all checks pass and no actionable comments or unresolved threads remain.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit PR #123 until it's ready to merge.
say_en.note: Claude will watch the PR until it can merge.

say_en.text: Monitor PR #456's CI and reviews, fix issues and push.
say_en.note: Claude polls checks and pushes fixes.

say_en.text: Keep watching #789, resolve all comments then report.
say_en.note: Claude verifies code, resolves threads, and reports.
